title: FinSight
text:
ISSS608 · Visual Analytics Project · AY2025-26
  FinSight
  A web-enabled visual analytics application for democratising customer intelligence in Colombian fintech — built with R Shiny.
  
    Read Proposal
    Meet the Team
  




  What we built
  Four modules. One application.
  FinSight integrates exploratory analysis, statistical testing, latent class clustering, and predictive modelling into a single interactive Shiny app.
  
    
      📊
      Exploratory Data Analysis
      Visualise customer demographics, product adoption, churn distribution and satisfaction patterns interactively.
    
    
      🔬
      Confirmatory Data Analysis
      Run Pearson correlation, ANOVA, and multiple linear regression to statistically validate key relationships.
    
    
      🧩
      Clustering — LCA
      Discover 5 latent customer segments using Latent Class Analysis across 18 behavioural and attitudinal variables.
    
    
      🌳
      Decision Tree & Random Forest
      Predict customer segment membership using rpart and ranger, with interactive parameter tuning and model comparison.

    The application
    Shiny App Modules
    Each tab of the FinSight app is independently developed and contributes a distinct analytical lens.
    

      
        
          Tab 01
          Exploratory Data Analysis
        
        
          Interactive histograms, correlation heatmap, faceted scatter plots by income and gender, satisfaction trends by CLV and tenure.
          
            ggplot2
            plotly
            ggcorrplot
          
          ▶ Open in App
        
      

      
        
          Tab 02
          Confirmatory Data Analysis
        
        
          Pearson correlation tests, one-way and two-way ANOVA, multiple linear regression with interactive variable selection and model comparison.
          
            broom
            ggplot2
            patchwork
          
          ▶ Open in App
        
      

      
        
          Tab 03
          Clustering — LCA
        
        
          Latent Class Analysis with adjustable classes and repetitions. BIC, AIC, entropy metrics. Interactive stacked bar charts for all 18 variables.
          
            poLCA
            plotly
            tidyverse
          
          ▶ Open in App
        
      

      
        
          Tab 04
          Decision Tree & Random Forest
        
        
          Pruned classification tree and random forest with interactive parameter tuning. Variable importance plot and confusion matrix comparison.
          
            rpart
            ranger
            caret
          
          ▶ Open in App
        
      

    
  




  Live application
  Try FinSight
  The full interactive application is deployed on shinyapps.io. Explore all four modules directly in your browser.
  ▶ Launch Shiny App




  
    The data
    COFINFAD Dataset
    Colombian Fintech Financial Analytics Dataset · Mendeley Data · DOI: 10.17632/mhb4zn3258.1 · CC BY 4.0
    
      
        customer_data.csv
        48,723 rows × 54 variables covering demographics, product holdings, app engagement, transaction behaviour, satisfaction scores, NPS, CLV segment, and churn probability.
      
      
        transactions_data.csv
        Detailed transaction-level records for the same customer base, covering transaction type, value, frequency, and timing across the full 2023 calendar year.
      
    
  




  The team
  Meet FinSight
  A team of three MITB students applying visual analytics to real-world fintech data.
  
    
      TC
      Teo Cher In
      EDA + CDA · Tab 1 & 2
      Exploratory and confirmatory analysis modules, including correlation, ANOVA, and regression testing.
    
    
      CW
      Cheng Ho Wang
      Clustering (LCA) · Tab 3
      Latent Class Analysis module, variable preparation, model evaluation, and interactive Shiny visualisations.
    
    
      YZ
      Ye Zhili
      Decision Tree & RF · Tab 4
      Classification tree and random forest modelling, hyperparameter tuning, and confusion matrix comparison.
    
  




  FinSight · ISSS608 Visual Analytics & Applications · Singapore Management University · 2026
